claim_limit: Two-task Development paired-interface feasibility only; no held-out performance, broad coding capability, model-weight improvement, or asynchronous learning claim.
freeze_status: frozen before model download and inference
hypothesis: The structured replacement interface may reduce invalid edit actions observed in earlier real-model traces; result is a two-task feasibility comparison only.
instruction: Identify the reported failure, inspect the named source file, make a minimal source-only repair, run the public test, and finish. Do not edit test files.

model.snapshot_download: Only the eight listed files at the exact revision; verify every SHA-256 before inference; run offline after download.

preregistration.analysis: Report exact paired task outcomes and descriptive success proportions. With two task clusters this is feasibility evidence only; no statistical capability-improvement claim, held-out claim, training claim, or generalization claim.
preregistration.exposure_history: Both task IDs were absent in prior tracked VARE model records and have model_attempted_before=false. Generic API familiarity is not ruled out. The #1978 RotatingKVCache API name appeared in non-model scripted analysis, documented in its task lock.
preregistration.paired_design: Each task is attempted once by each interface arm using the same checkpoint, greedy decoding, seed, task prompt, tool-turn/token/public-test limits, runtime image, and independent hidden grader. Interface-specific tool schema and edit instructions are the only planned treatment differences.
preregistration.primary_metric: Independently verified successful repairs per Development task at the fixed attempt budget, reported separately by interface arm with denominator 2.
preregistration.selection_rule: Select upstream MLX-LM PRs opened 2026-10-15 after the frozen public Qwen2.5-Coder model revision, absent as named tasks in prior tracked VARE model evidence; require pinned failing base, pinned known fix, independent public and trusted hidden calibration, and wrong-mutant rejection before model inference.
stopping_rules: Do not change model, prompt, task set, tool schema, decoding, budgets, or reward after first attempt.
Abort before inference if candidate isolation E0, pinned inputs, task controls, model hashes, or resource preflight fail.
Retain timeout, crash, malformed-tool, no-edit, public failure, hidden failure, and resource-abort records.
If all four attempts yield zero verified repairs, classify failure and stop; do not tune prompts or launch SFT/GRPO.
preregistration.task_split: Development only; neither task contributes to training or held-out capability claims.
preregistration.training: No student update, SFT, GRPO, or policy-learning claim is authorized by this two-task feasibility protocol.

research_question: On two fresh Development repository-repair tasks, does replacing free-form unified-diff edits with bounded source reads and exact unique-string replacement improve independently verified repair success for the same frozen local coding model under matched budgets?

runtime.candidate_execution: Docker candidate execution has network disabled, read-only root, dropped capabilities, bounded memory/CPU/PIDs, and only the source workspace mounted. The hidden grader is copied to a separate post-inference workspace/container and never mounted during model execution.
runtime.candidate_image_build: docker build --platform linux/arm64 -f Dockerfile.candidate -t vare-real-agent-candidate-v1 . (run from benchmarks/mlsys_real_agent_interface_v1; Dockerfile base and all installed dependency hashes are pinned).
runtime.host: Apple M1 Pro / 32 GiB / macOS arm64
